In-app subscription
The app is free but to use ROUVY, you'll need a subscription which costs $14.99/month. You can try out ROUVY with a free 14-day trial. 
Simply create an account, connect your trainer to the app via bluetooth and follow the prompts to begin your indoor cycling experience.
